teks_soal: Based on the notice board in the picture, what are visitors prohibited from bringing into the Eco-Park?

opsi_jawaban.label: A
opsi_jawaban.teks: Reusable tumblers

opsi_jawaban.label: B
opsi_jawaban.teks: Bicycles

opsi_jawaban.label: C
opsi_jawaban.teks: Single-use plastic bottles

opsi_jawaban.label: D
opsi_jawaban.teks: Backpacks

pembahasan: Pada papan peraturan tercantum tanda larangan bergambar botol dan tulisan: "NO PLASTIC BOTTLES" (botol plastik sekali pakai).

teks_soal: Where are visitors allowed to ride their bicycles according to the sign?

opsi_jawaban.label: A
opsi_jawaban.teks: Anywhere on the grass lawn

opsi_jawaban.label: B
opsi_jawaban.teks: Only on the designated bicycle lane

opsi_jawaban.label: C
opsi_jawaban.teks: Inside the park administration office

opsi_jawaban.label: D
opsi_jawaban.teks: On the pedestrian sidewalk among crowds

pembahasan: Aturan ketiga pada papan menyatakan secara spesifik: "BICYCLES ONLY ON DESIGNATED LANE" (hanya di jalur sepeda yang ditentukan).

teks_soal:
[Pilihan Ganda Kompleks — Pilih Lebih dari Satu!]
Which actions are obedient to the Eco-Park rules? (Choose TWO correct answers)

opsi_jawaban.label: A
opsi_jawaban.teks: Throwing snack wrappers into the designated trash can.

opsi_jawaban.label: B
opsi_jawaban.teks: Bringing a refillable stainless steel tumbler for drinking.

opsi_jawaban.label: C
opsi_jawaban.teks: Riding a bicycle carelessly across the flower gardens.

opsi_jawaban.label: D
opsi_jawaban.teks: Leaving single-use plastic bottles on the wooden benches.

pembahasan: Pilihan A mematuhi "KEEP THE PARK CLEAN" dan B mematuhi larangan botol plastik dengan membawa tumbler isi ulang. Pilihan C dan D melanggar aturan taman.

teks_soal: [Tabel Benar / Salah (True or False)] Read the statements based on the notice board and give a tick in the True or False column!

pernyataan.teks: Visitors who throw trash carelessly on the ground will have to pay a fine of Rp50.000.
The notice board above is placed inside a hospital operating room.
Visitors can refill their reusable drinking bottles for free near the main gate.

pembahasan: (a) True: denda buang sampah sembarangan adalah Rp50.000. (b) False: papan berada di gerbang taman (Eco-Park), bukan kamar operasi rumah sakit. (c) True: tersedia stasiun isi ulang air minum gratis di dekat gerbang.

teks_soal: Why does the Eco-Park management put up the sign "NO PLASTIC BOTTLES"?

opsi_jawaban.label: A
opsi_jawaban.teks: To make visitors thirsty during their walk.

opsi_jawaban.label: B
opsi_jawaban.teks: To sell more plastic bags at the gate.

opsi_jawaban.label: C
opsi_jawaban.teks: To reduce plastic waste and protect the environment.

opsi_jawaban.label: D
opsi_jawaban.teks: To forbid students from exercising.

pembahasan: Tujuan peraturan larangan botol plastik adalah untuk mengurangi sampah plastik dan melestarikan lingkungan alam di taman (to reduce plastic waste and protect the environment).

bacaan.teks:
Compare the two digital warning notices below for questions number 26 to 30!

• NOTICE 1 (At the School Computer Lab): "CAUTION: DO NOT CLICK UNKNOWN LINKS OR SHARE YOUR PASSWORD. LOG OUT OF YOUR ACCOUNT BEFORE LEAVING THE COMPUTER."
• NOTICE 2 (At the Science Laboratory): "WARNING: CORROSIVE CHEMICALS. WEAR GLOVES AND SAFETY GOGGLES AT ALL TIMES. WASH HANDS THOROUGHLY AFTER EXPERIMENT."

teks_soal: [Membandingkan Dua Notice] How do Notice 1 and Notice 2 differ in their safety focus?

opsi_jawaban.label: A
opsi_jawaban.teks: Notice 1 focuses on cybersecurity and data privacy, while Notice 2 focuses on physical safety from hazardous chemicals.

opsi_jawaban.label: B
opsi_jawaban.teks: Notice 1 is found at a swimming pool, while Notice 2 is found at a library.

opsi_jawaban.label: C
opsi_jawaban.teks: Both notices tell students to share their passwords with strangers.

opsi_jawaban.label: D
opsi_jawaban.teks: Notice 1 is for chemistry teachers, while Notice 2 is for computer programmers.

pembahasan: Notice 1 berfokus pada keamanan digital (cybersecurity) di lab komputer, sedangkan Notice 2 berfokus pada keselamatan fisik dari zat kimia korosif di lab sains.

• NOTICE 2 (At the Science Laboratory): "WARNING: CORROSIVE CHEMICALS. WEAR GLOVES AND SAFETY GOGGLES AT ALL TIMES. WASH HANDS THOROUGHLY AFTER EXPERIMENT."

teks_soal: What might happen if a student ignores Notice 1 and forgets to log out of a public computer?

opsi_jawaban.label: A
opsi_jawaban.teks: The computer screen will melt from chemicals.

opsi_jawaban.label: B
opsi_jawaban.teks: Another person might access and misuse the student’s personal account.

opsi_jawaban.label: C
opsi_jawaban.teks: The student will get a free laptop from the school.

opsi_jawaban.label: D
opsi_jawaban.teks: The internet connection will become faster.

pembahasan: Jika lupa keluar (log out) dari komputer umum, akun siswa rawan disalahgunakan atau diakses oleh pengguna lain.

teks_soal: In Notice 2, the word "corrosive" is closest in meaning to ....

opsi_jawaban.label: A
opsi_jawaban.teks: safe and sweet to drink

opsi_jawaban.label: B
opsi_jawaban.teks: cold and refreshing

opsi_jawaban.label: C
opsi_jawaban.teks: able to damage or burn skin and materials

opsi_jawaban.label: D
opsi_jawaban.teks: very cheap and easy to find

pembahasan: Kata "corrosive" berarti zat yang bersifat merusak, mengikis, atau melukai kulit dan benda (able to damage or burn skin and materials).

teks_soal:
[Pilihan Ganda Kompleks — Pilih Lebih dari Satu!]
What must students do according to Notice 2? (Choose TWO correct answers)

opsi_jawaban.label: A
opsi_jawaban.teks: Wear protective gloves and safety goggles during the experiment.

opsi_jawaban.label: B
opsi_jawaban.teks: Wash their hands thoroughly after finishing the experiment.

opsi_jawaban.label: C
opsi_jawaban.teks: Taste the chemicals with a spoon.

opsi_jawaban.label: D
opsi_jawaban.teks: Share their email password on the whiteboard.

pembahasan: Notice 2 memerintahkan dua hal: memakai sarung tangan & kacamata pelindung (A) serta mencuci tangan hingga bersih setelah percobaan (B).
